issues.title: Actual treatment names a numeric dose source for a text variable
issues.summary: Define-XML gives ADSL.TRT01AN (the numeric dose) as the TRTA source; the specification and the reference hold the treatment label from ADSL.TRT01A.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.TRTA is a copy of ADSL.TRT01AN.
issues.observed: The specification reads ADSL1.TRT01A (ADSL.TRT01A). The reference differs from ADSL.TRT01AN on 32139 of 32139 records, e.g. it holds Placebo where TRT01AN holds 0.
issues.action: Correct Define-XML ADVS.TRTA to name ADSL.TRT01A, the text source the specification and reference use.

issues.title: SAP gives two different End of Treatment visit definitions
issues.summary: SAP page 10 and the vital-sign shells on pages 40-42 define End of Treatment differently, and neither gives an operational rule for the derived ADVS End of Treatment record.
issues.expected: SAP page 10: the Week 24 visit or early termination visit. SAP pages 40-42: the last on-treatment visit on or before the Week 24 visit.
issues.observed: The two definitions can select different records. No document states candidate visits, the on-treatment date test, ties or no-candidate handling; R Consortium Pilot 6 reimplementation advs.r L156-L168 keeps the last record with AVISITN > 2.
issues.action: Decide which End of Treatment definition governs ADVS and document candidate visits, the on-treatment test, repeated-assessment ties and no-candidate behavior.

citations.quote: Derived from VS.VISIT for values to be included in a per visit analysis. AVISIT is missing for values from SDTM screening visits, unscheduled visits, and event related visits, e.g. "AMBUL ECG REMOVAL", which are not included in a per visit analysis.

issues.title: End of Treatment visit has no Week 24 bound or on-treatment test
issues.summary: The specification keeps the highest mapped visit, through Week 26, as End of Treatment; the SAP shells require the last on-treatment visit on or before Week 24.
issues.expected: SAP page 40: End of treatment is the last on-treatment visit (on or before the Week 24 visit).
issues.observed: advs.yaml eot ranks _SRC_AVISITN descending among mapped visits up to Week 26 and keeps _RANK = 1 AND _SRC_AVISITN > 2; it has no Week 24 bound and no on-treatment test.
issues.action: Once the governing definition is settled, add the Week 24 bound and on-treatment test to the eot branch, or document the ranking it uses.

issues.title: Percent change is stored unrounded despite one declared decimal
issues.summary: Define-XML declares PCHG = 100*(CHG/BASE) with Significant digits: 1; the reference keeps full precision, which the unrounded reading reproduces.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.PCHG: 100* (CHG/BASE), Significant digits: 1, with CHG = AVAL-BASE.
issues.observed: With the declared precision the documented rule differs from the reference on 23060 of 32139 records; unrounded it matches every record. R Consortium Pilot 6 reimplementation advs.r L182-L183 also does not round.
issues.action: Decide whether PCHG is stored at one decimal; then correct the Define-XML precision or round the stored values.

issues.title: Study identifier is read from VS instead of ADSL
issues.summary: Define-XML and the data guide name ADSL as the STUDYID source; the specification reads VS.STUDYID.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.STUDYID: ADSL.STUDYID. Data guide page 4: core variables, including STUDYID, were merged from ADSL into all analysis datasets.
issues.observed: advs.yaml STUDYID: derivation: VS.STUDYID. The ADSL1 join supplies other columns, not this one.
issues.action: Read STUDYID from ADSL in the specification, or document why the VS value is used.

issues.title: Subject identifier is read from VS instead of ADSL
issues.summary: Define-XML and the data guide name ADSL as the USUBJID source; the specification reads VS.USUBJID.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.USUBJID: ADSL.USUBJID. Data guide page 4: core variables, including USUBJID, were merged from ADSL into all analysis datasets.
issues.observed: advs.yaml USUBJID: derivation: VS.USUBJID. USUBJID is used to join ADSL1 but its value is not taken from ADSL.
issues.action: Read USUBJID from ADSL in the specification, or document why the VS value is used.

issues.title: Baseline record is chosen by visit label, not the baseline flag
issues.summary: Define-XML selects the BASE record where VSBLFL="Y" and the SAP takes baseline height at Visit 1; the specification selects VS.VISIT = BASELINE for every parameter.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.BASE: VS.VSSTRESN where VSBLFL="Y". SAP page 13: baseline weight and BMI at Visit 3, height at Visit 1.
issues.observed: advs.yaml BASE1 filters VS.VISIT = 'BASELINE' for every vital-sign parameter and does not read VSBLFL.
issues.action: Select baseline by VSBLFL="Y" as Define-XML states, or document that the BASELINE visit defines the flag; confirm whether the Visit 1 height rule applies to ADVS.

issues.title: Baseline lookup keys, repeated records and precision are not documented
issues.summary: Define-XML gives the BASE source and flag but not the lookup grouping, repeated-baseline handling or parameter-level precision, so no complete rule could be probed.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.BASE: VS.VSSTRESN where VSBLFL="Y", Significant digits: 1; the cited section states no grouping keys or tie rule.
issues.observed: The verifier could not state the rule as a probe. R Consortium Pilot 6 reimplementation advs.r L170-L181 takes BASE from the ABLFL = Y record within STUDYID, USUBJID, PARAMCD and BASETYPE.
issues.action: Document the baseline grouping keys, handling of repeated flagged records and the parameter-level precision in citable ADaM metadata.

issues.title: End of Treatment analysis flag skips the SAP endpoint conditions
issues.summary: The SAP defines the endpoint visit by Week 24, early termination or last on-treatment visit; the specification flags its eot record, chosen without those conditions.
issues.expected: SAP page 17: last visit on or before Week 24. Page 40: last on-treatment visit. Page 10: the Week 24 visit or early termination visit.
issues.observed: advs.yaml eot ranks all mapped visits, including Week 26, with no Week 24 bound, on-treatment test or early-termination candidate; ANL01FL flags every emitted End of Treatment record.
issues.action: Once the governing End of Treatment definition is settled, flag only the record it selects: add the Week 24 bound and on-treatment test.

issues.title: Flagged End of Treatment requires a visit after Week 2 without a documented rule
issues.summary: The specification eot filter requires a mapped source visit after Week 2 before the End of Treatment record is flagged; no retained document states this cutoff.
issues.expected: SAP pages 10, 17 and 40-42 state the endpoint visit criteria without a cutoff after Week 2.
issues.action: Document the after-Week-2 cutoff as an analysis convention, or remove it from the eot filter.

issues.title: Analysis flag eligibility is not fully documented
issues.summary: Define-XML gives the ANL01FL meaning and excluded visits but not whether derived End of Treatment records, repeated assessments or missing values are flagged.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.ANL01FL: Y if the value is to be included in a per visit analysis; missing for screening, unscheduled and event related visits.
issues.observed: No complete rule could be probed. R Consortium Pilot 6 reimplementation advs.r L185-L192 flags every record with nonmissing AVISIT, including each added End of Treatment record.
issues.action: Document which records are flagged: repeated assessments, missing values and derived End of Treatment records.

citations.quote: ANL01FL="Y" if the value is to be included in a per visit analysis. ANL01FL is missing for values from SDTM screening visits, unscheduled visits, and event related visits, e.g. "AMBUL ECG REMOVAL"

issues.title: Baseline flag is derived from the visit label, not copied from VSBLFL
issues.summary: Define-XML names VS.VSBLFL as the ABLFL source; the specification derives ABLFL from VS.VISIT. The reference still equals VSBLFL.
issues.observed: advs.yaml ABLFL is a case expression on VS.VISIT = 'BASELINE'. The reference equals VS.VSBLFL on all 32139 records compared.
issues.action: Copy ABLFL from VS.VSBLFL as Define-XML states, or document the visit-label derivation.

issues.title: Analysis date completes partial dates without a documented rule
issues.summary: The specification sets a missing month and day of VSDTC to 1; no retained document gives a partial-date rule for vital-sign dates.
issues.expected: No retained document states a partial-date completion for ADVS.ADT; Define-XML states only the date part of VS.VSDTC.
issues.observed: advs.yaml ADT completes partial dates with month: 1 and day: 1.
issues.action: Remove the completion so partial dates stay missing, or document the intended imputation policy.

issues.title: Numeric timepoint code has no documented coding
issues.summary: Define-XML says only "Numeric code for ATPT" with no codelist or source; the specification copies VS.VSTPTNUM, which no retained document names.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADVS.ATPTN: Numeric code for ATPT, with no codelist or source variable.
issues.observed: advs.yaml ATPTN: derivation: VS.VSTPTNUM. R Consortium Pilot 6 reimplementation advs.r L43-L53 and L140-L143 instead take ATPTN from its own specification codelist joined on ATPT.
issues.action: Document the ATPTN coding in ADaM metadata, VSTPTNUM or a codelist, including the code for records with no timepoint.

issues.title: Change from baseline precision is missing from the cited metadata
issues.summary: Define-XML gives CHG = AVAL-BASE with a general Significant digits: 1; the parameter-level precision is not in the cited section, so the complete rule could not be probed.
issues.observed: The verifier could not state a complete rule as a probe. R Consortium Pilot 6 reimplementation advs.r L170-L182 derives CHG with derive_var_chg() and no rounding.
issues.action: Expose the parameter-level CHG precision in citable ADaM metadata, or confirm that CHG is stored unrounded.
